messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Rattle 5.0.11 fixes RGtk2 2.20.33 issues
parts:
I've updated Rattle in version 5.0.11 to fix a few issues following the release of RGtk2 2.20.33.

It has been tested on Ubuntu and limited testing on Windows.

It is not backward compatible with RGtk2 2.20.31.

Particularly for those users originally receiving the following error please update both rattle and RGtk2 to confirm the issue has been rectified and confirm here: 

Error in method(obj, ...) : Invalid root element: 'requires'

To update:

> install.packages("RGtk2")
> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Thanks, Graham Williams
